            }

        } catch (IOException io) {
            io.printStackTrace();
        }

    private static int countEvenRuns(char[] s, int index, char curChar, int curSeq, int result) {
        if (index >= s.length) {
            return result;
        }
        if (s[index] != curChar) {
            if (curSeq % 2 == 0) {
                result++;
            }
            return countEvenRuns(s, index + 1, s[index], 1, result);
        } else {
            return countEvenRuns(s, index + 1, curChar, curSeq + 1, result);
        }
    }
}

import java.util.regex.Pattern;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        try {
            BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
            String input = br.readLine();
            Pattern pattern = Pattern.compile("(.)\\1*");
            Matcher matcher = pattern.matcher(input);
            List<String> runs = new ArrayList<String>();
            while (matcher.find()) {
                runs.add(matcher.group());
            }
            int result = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < runs.size() - 1; i++) {
                if (runs.get(i).length() % 2 == 0) {
                    result++;
                }
            }
            System.out.println(result);
        } catch (IOException io) {

        }
    }
}
